$comment: E2E baseline: the fixed test data every run needs. e2e/seed/seed.ts makes sure it exists once per run (safe to repeat). Users are listed by role; their user names and passwords come from helpers/auth.ts (M8FLOW_E2E_<ROLE>_USERNAME / _PASSWORD). Data a test changes is NOT listed here: tests keep creating their own.

users.why: starts processes and fills the first form
works tasks in the Approvers lane
works Administrators-lane tasks; reads every instance
access checks for the integrator role

platformAdmins.why: tenant management, second tenant, cross-tenant checks

secondTenant.$comment: Used by the tenant tests (PAR-03, FLW-52/53); slug and name come from helpers/fixtures.ts. 'users' are test users that belong ONLY to this tenant: each gets its own group with one role. Password = user name unless M8FLOW_E2E_TENANT2_PASSWORD is set. Emails use baseline.example.test so the invited-user clean-up never removes them.

mockModel.$comment: The shared 'E2E Mock Catalog' / 'E2E Mock Model' the modeler specs open (helpers/fixtures.ts)
